newsitem.title: MEXICO: ECE to open two Rainforest Cafes in Mexico.
newsitem.headline: ECE to open two Rainforest Cafes in Mexico.

text.p: Mexican restaurant company Grupo ECE said on Monday it planned to open the first two franshises of the Rainforest Cafe Inc chain in Mexico this year.
The first of the two restaurants was slated to open by week's end in the Caribbean tourist resort of Cancun. It and a nearby Hard Rock Cafe cost $4.5 million to build, it said.
The second Rainforest Cafe restaurant was due to open in Mexico City by year's end and cost $3 million to build.
ECE is the operator of theme restaurants and owns the franchises in Mexico to the popular restaurant chains Planet Hollywood, Hard Rock Cafe, and Official All Star Cafe.
Planet Hollywood International Inc owns a 20 percent stake in the company.
